meta.title_en: Eye Training #2 — I Got It Again

scenes.title_cn: 恢复有神：拍照拍久了眼睛变得无神。这…
scenes.title_en: Bring back the spark: after long photo ses…
sentences: 拍照拍久了，眼睛变得无神。
After long photo sessions, your eyes go lifeless.
只需要把眉毛抬起来，再放松，眼睛就会找到有神的感觉。
Just raise the brows, then relax—your eyes find the spark.
scenes.speak: After long photo sessions, your eyes go lifeless. Just raise the brows, then relax—your eyes find the spark.

scenes.title_cn: 侧脸眼神：想要拍出好看的侧脸，眼球的…
scenes.title_en: Profile gaze: for a good side profile, the…
scenes.context: 眼珠转向与脸转向相反。
sentences: 眼球的转动方向和脸的转动方向要相反。
The eyeball turns opposite to the face.
脸往右边转，眼睛就要往左边看。
Turn the face right, and the eyes look left.
face right, eyes left（脸右眼左）
这样拍出来的侧脸眼神就不会无神。
That keeps the profile gaze alive.
scenes.speak: The eyeball turns opposite to the face. Turn the face right, and the eyes look left. That keeps the profile gaze alive.

practice: Turn the eyeballs opposite to the face.
pitfalls: Raise the brows, then relax to find the spark.
抬眉再放松，眼睛就有神。
Turn face and eyes the same way.
The eyeball turns opposite to the face.
侧脸时眼珠转向与脸相反。
Forget the opposite rule on every profile.
Apply it every time you shoot a profile.
每条侧脸都要用反向眼神。
shifts: 用 lifeless（无神）、find the spark（找到有神的感觉）
用 opposite direction（相反方向）、face right eyes left（脸右眼左）
用 eye training（眼神训练）、eyebrow raise（抬眉）、relax（放松）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：眼睛无神、眉毛抬起来再放松、有神的感觉、侧脸、眼球转动方向和脸相反、脸往右边转眼睛往左边看、眼神无神等。
